system.description:
By standing your ground, you focus your mind to repel any assault.

Prerequisite: Base Attack Bonus +1

Effect: When you Fight Defensively, you gain a +2 morale bonus to your Will Defense. If you make no attacks until your next turn, you gain a +5 morale bonus to your Will Defense until the start of your next turn.

Normal: When you Fight Defensively you only get a dodge bonus to your Reflex Defense.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy of Intrigue
